cards.card_text: True or false: The priest who offers the sin offering eats it.
cards.verse_text: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
cards.snippet: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place,…

cards.card_text: If someone offers it in thanksgiving, he brings unleavened cakes, unleavened wafers, cakes of fine flour and cakes of leavened bread with it, and one portion of each goes to the priest who sprinkles the blood.
cards.verse_text: Now this is the law of the peace offering that one may present to the LORD: If he offers it in thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil, unleavened wafers coated with oil, and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil.

cards.card_text: God says anyone who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice but doesn't bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting must be cut off from his people, even a foreigner living among the Israelites.
cards.verse_text: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man must be cut off from his people.

cards.card_text: Whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig's blood, and whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.
cards.verse_text: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.
cards.snippet: …a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.
